'''N-30H''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that was often used to assist [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
